name: vol-targeted-multi-sleeve
notes: Runner-level ensemble: H021 + H086 + H078 + H089 blended via inverse-vol weights. Weights = 1/sigma (252d trailing vol), normalized; quarterly rebalance only (first trading day of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct). Risk-parity applied at strategy level. Vol computed on OOS returns; no lookahead (weights use realized, not prospective vol).
